check_static_imports: check static imports in huggingface_hub __init__.py for consistency with _SUBMOD_ATTRS
update_static_imports: update static imports in huggingface_hub __init__.py by running check_static_imports with --update flag
reformat_submod_attrs: reformat _SUBMOD_ATTRS dictionary to be alphabetically ordered in __init__.py
validate_init_file: validate that __init__.py static imports match the lazy-loading _SUBMOD_ATTRS definitions
run_ruff_formatting: run ruff check and format on generated __init__.py content to enforce code style
